create_WanVAEArchConfig: create a WanVAEArchConfig dataclass instance with custom base_dim, z_dim, and dim_mult for a video VAE architecture
create_WanVAEConfig: create a WanVAEConfig dataclass instance with custom tiling and parallel encode/decode settings for video latent processing
build_VAE_scaling_factors: build scaling_factor and shift_factor tensors from latents_mean and latents_std in WanVAEArchConfig for latent normalization
configure_VAE_tiling: configure WanVAEConfig with use_tiling, use_temporal_tiling, and use_parallel_tiling flags for memory-efficient video inference
